prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a bustling airport gate. On the left, a woman in a blue coat stands holding a boarding pass, her posture upright and alert. Next to her sits a black rolling suitcase, its handle extended upward. In the center, a child in a yellow raincoat points excitedly toward the large window, drawing the attention of a man in a gray suit who is looking at the same distant plane. The man in the gray suit sits on a metal bench, his legs crossed casually. Beside him, a brown dog rests its head on the man's knee, appearing calm amidst the chaos. To the right, an elderly woman in a floral dress hands a small toy to the child in the yellow raincoat, bridging the gap between strangers. Behind them, a flight attendant in a navy uniform checks a clipboard, standing near a digital display screen that glows faintly. A potted fern sits next to the digital display, adding a touch of green to the sterile environment. Near the far wall, a teenager in headphones leans against a pillar, eyes closed in rest. There is no food visible in the scene, ensuring the focus remains on travel preparations. There is no luggage cart present, keeping the foreground uncluttered. The woman in the blue coat looks at the flight attendant, perhaps seeking confirmation. The black rolling suitcase is positioned firmly under the hand of the woman in the blue coat. The child in the yellow raincoat interacts directly with the elderly woman in the floral dress through the exchange of the toy. The brown dog maintains physical contact with the man in the gray suit by resting on his leg. The spatial arrangement places the woman in the blue coat on the left, the seated pair in the center, and the interacting trio on the right, creating a balanced narrative flow across the terminal space.
